content:
maya: FYI release cut for v2.3.0 is blocked — CI parallel-matrix has been stuck in PENDING for 45m and artifact upload shows 'stream truncated'. Anyone on it?
ci-bot: matrix job 1782 stuck on runner 'gke-jenkins-05', last seen starting shard 6/12.
alex: I'm looking — logs show repeated TCP reset during multipart upload to s3-proxy. grabbing logs.
alex: ```
ERROR: upload failed: unexpected EOF while reading chunk 4/16
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "upload.py", line 212, in stream_part
  ...
ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer
```
deploy-bot: promote blocked: artifact digest mismatch with last-good on mirror. auto-retry exhausted (5/5).
lee: @alex can you correlate with runner eviction / node reboot in cloud? I saw node pool scaling events earlier.
jordyn: CI infra: there was a kubelet restart on gke-jenkins-05 at 10:12 UTC (node tainted, restarted pods) — likely caused the TCP resets.
sophie: two options: 1) rerun the matrix on a different runner pool (slower) 2) manual pin to previous promoted artifact (safe, but delays release notes update). Thoughts?
maya: prefer minimal blast radius — pin to last-promoted artifact and cut release notes now? We need customer-facing doc update.
alex: can we verify last-promoted passed all gating tests? If yes, i'd vote pin.
ci-bot: last-promoted 2.2.9 passed full matrix 12m ago, no regressions.
maya: ok — pin to 2.2.9 for this window. @deploy-bot please hold v2.3.0 and mark for re-run in next change window. @ops-team please follow up on gke node eviction root cause.
deploy-bot: acknowledged. Holding v2.3.0, pinned release to 2.2.9. Created ticket INF-3421 to investigate uploader timeouts.
lee: will open cloud support ticket and add kubelet logs to INF-3421.
jordyn: scheduling a rerun for v2.3.0 on the cross-region pool in next window; will update thread.
maya: thanks all. :thumbsup:
